events.continuity_hook: Carry the chosen departure strategy, Sunday return, and any required Wednesday hotel into the reservation session.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the full trip cost and usable visit time for both departure strategies, then select one outbound flight, one Sunday return, and a hotel only if the Wednesday option wins.
events.scenario_brief: The relatives have confirmed that Marcus, his husband, and their son can stay with them from Thursday through Sunday, but not on Wednesday night. The family must now compare an after-school Wednesday flight plus one airport-area hotel night with an early Thursday departure, using complete costs and realistic arrival times to determine how much additional family time Wednesday travel actually provides.

events.continuity_hook: Keep the completed Seattle flight and first-night hotel details available for any airline schedule movement before Thanksgiving.
events.interaction_goal: Verify all three travelers, complete the round-trip flight purchase and Wednesday hotel reservation, and consolidate the arrival and Thursday-morning transportation plan.
events.scenario_brief: Marcus and his husband have decided that the Wednesday flight creates enough additional time with the relatives to justify the extra night. The selected outbound and Sunday return are still available for three travelers, and an airport-area room has been identified, but the airfare total, room occupancy, late check-in, guest names, and transportation to the relatives' home on Thursday morning still need to be checked together.

events.continuity_hook: Leave the family with a confirmed Sunday return and an updated arrival time while preserving the rest of the Seattle itinerary.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the altered return with earlier Sunday options, account for airport-to-home time in Chicago, and retain or rebook the return for all three travelers.
events.scenario_brief: Twelve days before Thanksgiving, the airline has moved the family's Sunday flight later by nearly two hours, producing an arrival in Chicago after 10:30 p.m. Marcus needs to determine whether an earlier nonstop still has three seats at a reasonable total or whether the booked flight remains workable for school and work on Monday; the Wednesday outbound and hotel are unchanged.

events.continuity_hook: Carry one Monday-evening outbound and two Wednesday return candidates into the hotel and schedule decision.
events.interaction_goal: Identify a workable outbound and compare Wednesday returns under both the stated finish time and a possible late meeting, including realistic airport transfer time.
events.scenario_brief: Marcus has been assigned to a two-day restaurant opening review in suburban Phoenix. The first site walkthrough begins at 9:00 a.m. Tuesday and the final meeting should end by 4:00 p.m. Wednesday, but the local team has not confirmed whether Wednesday may run late. He needs round-trip options from Chicago that make the Tuesday start dependable without committing too early to an impractical return.

events.continuity_hook: Retain the two strongest hotel choices with their drive-time tradeoffs for selection once Wednesday's meeting end time is fixed.
events.interaction_goal: Compare practical hotels for the two work locations, verify full two-night costs and terms, and narrow the choice to a primary property and one fallback.
events.scenario_brief: The Phoenix team has supplied the restaurant address and confirmed that Marcus will also spend Wednesday morning at a district office fifteen miles away. The initial airport hotel is poorly placed for both sites, so he needs two-night alternatives between them with complete reimbursable totals, parking costs for a rental car, and cancellation terms.

events.continuity_hook: Keep the completed Phoenix itinerary and Wednesday airport-transfer assumptions available in case the opening agenda shifts.
events.interaction_goal: Validate the final meeting-to-airport schedule, confirm the flight and hotel totals and terms, and complete the reservations for the two-day work trip.
events.scenario_brief: The local team has fixed Wednesday's final meeting to end at 4:30 p.m., ruling out the earliest return flight. Marcus has selected the hotel that balances both work locations, and now needs the Monday outbound, later Wednesday return, two-night stay, and rental-car timing reconciled before booking.
